title: SpaceX Begins Rolling Out Starlink Mini Plus to Existing Customers
body: SpaceX has started shipping the Starlink Mini Plus terminal to existing roaming-tier customers in the United States and Canada this month. The new hardware adds dual-band Wi-Fi 6 and a built-in battery rated for four hours of untethered operation, addressing two of the most-requested features from the Mini's first year on the market. SpaceX did not disclose unit pricing for new buyers; existing customers receive the upgrade at the previously announced $599 hardware fee. No changes were announced to the underlying constellation or the company's launch cadence.

expected.description: SpaceX is shipping a hardware refresh of its Starlink Mini terminal — a single-vendor product release, not a partnership.
